key_concepts.definition: New sessions load this file first from GitHub (CS1 in SSM §12). Single source of truth for system state, identity, laws, and recent decisions.
Every pulse run must produce a GitHub commit SHA. If Notion AI disappeared, what permanent artifact did this run create? If answer = only updated Notion state → RUN FAILED.
3-line digest updated every pulse: current vector, active principles (3-5), open rulings. Warm layer of reincarnation protocol.
First run after 08:00 ICT generates overnight summary for Michael: pages exported, holes found, items created/closed, grades, artifact count + SHAs, top recommendation.
Systematic conversion of all canon markdown files to structured JSON. Each entry preserves verbatim quotes, key concepts, cross-references, and canon guardrails.
Notion = workspace/control plane. GitHub = vault/permanent record. Never reverse. Cold starts load from GitHub.
Every SEED artifact makes rebuild from GitHub alone possible. L28 in SSM Core Laws.
